product_statement: The current live product is a bounded Document Protocol Lab pilot for three SEC Item 1A fixtures.
anti_hype_statement: Document Protocol Lab currently ships this deliberately compact three-case pilot, not a broad issuer catalog or research platform.
why_this_mix_matters: NVDA gives the clearest first filing answer, LLY tests the protocol in a bounded policy-heavy setting, and KO checks whether the same workflow stays honest on a mostly stable filing.
